hadith:
Virtues of the Qur'an - Narrated Abu-Huraira:

Gabriel used to repeat the recitation of the Qur'an with the Prophet (ﷺ) once a year, but he repeated it twice with him in the year he died. The Prophet (ﷺ) used to stay in I`tikaf for ten days every year (in the month of Ramadan), but in the year of his death, he stayed in I`tikaf for twenty days.
message: In the Name of Allah—the Most Beneficent, Most Merciful
name:
Al Waliyy - الْوَلِيُّ - The Protector

The name Al Waliyy reflects Allah's protective nature and His intimate relationship with His believers. Originating from Arabic, it highlights the concept of divine guardianship, where Allah assists, nurtures, and supports those who seek His help, ensuring their well-being in both spiritual and worldly matters.
verse:
Al-Anfal - The Spoils of War - 8:40

And if they do not comply, then know that Allah is your Protector. What an excellent Protector, and what an excellent Helper!
